channel.title: Sonneblom Digitaal: Christmas Printables & Games
channel.description: Christmas Printables & Games from Sonneblom Digitaal

item.title: Christmas Mega Bundle: Party Games
item.description: Everything you need for a fun, screen-free Christmas: party games for the grown-ups, activities for the kids, bingo for everyone and a gift-exchange game, all in one money-saving bundle.

item.title: Christmas Escape Room for Kids
item.description: Oh no! Sneaky Jack Frost has frozen the door of Santa's Workshop shut, with Santa, the elves and every present stuck inside. Can your kids crack six puzzles and escape before midnight?

item.title: Christmas Murder Mystery Game Printable
item.description: Can you solve the murder at the Mistletoe Ball?

item.title: 30 Christmas Minute to Win It Games
item.description: Get everyone laughing with 30 fast, festive Minute to Win It games! Each challenge takes just 60 seconds and uses cheap, easy-to-find supplies like cups, candy canes, cotton balls and marshmallows.

item.title: Christmas Activity Pack for Kids
item.description: Screen-free Christmas fun for kids aged 4 to 10! Print as many copies as you need for the family, a classroom or a Christmas party.

item.title: Christmas Bingo
item.description: Christmas Bingo for the whole family, classroom or office party: 100 unique picture bingo cards and 50 unique word bingo cards, ready to print.

item.title: 2026 Christmas Planner Printable
item.description: Take the stress out of Christmas with a calm, organised printable holiday planner. Dated for Christmas 2026, with Sunday-start and Monday-start calendars in US Letter and A4.

item.title: 2027 New Year's Eve Party Games Bundle
item.description: Ring in 2027 with a bundle of fun, printable New Year's Eve party games for family, friends, kids and colleagues. Answer keys included.
